title: tc-publish-readiness
description:
What must pass before something is released: a summary card with one tick per check that opens a dialog of the
checks, the blockers behind failing ones and the publish action, held back while anything blocks.

subject.description: What is being released, e.g. "Daily briefing"

confirmed.description: Ids of the manual checks the person has signed off

publishDisabled.description: Keep the publish action off even when ready – nothing to publish to yet

plainBlockers.description: Show blockers as plain text instead of links (nothing opens them)

label.description: What must hold, e.g. "Spec is valid"

state.description: passed / failed (has blockers) / pending (runs later, e.g. during approval) / manual (a person signs it off)

detail.description: A line of detail – shown under the checklist for checks that run later, and in the blocker list

blockers.description: Why a failed check fails – each one opens with tc-open-blocker

label.description: What blocks, e.g. "Step 4 has no reviewer"
